# College Board

> College Board is a nonprofit organization that helps students prepare for college and career through programs including SAT, AP, BigFuture, CLEP, and ACCUPLACER.

College Board serves students, families, educators, schools, and higher education institutions with assessment programs, college planning tools, financial aid guidance, research, and professional resources.

## Main Site and Organization
- [College Board Home](https://www.collegeboard.org/): Main entry point for College Board programs, services, and organizational information.
- [About Us](https://about.collegeboard.org/): Overview of College Board’s mission, history, leadership, and impact.
- [Membership](https://membership.collegeboard.org/): Information about College Board membership for educators, schools, and institutions.
- [Newsroom](https://newsroom.collegeboard.org/): Official announcements, press releases, statements, and media resources.
- [Research](https://research.collegeboard.org/): Research reports, data insights, and policy publications on education and assessment.
- [Events](https://events.collegeboard.org/): Conferences, webinars, and professional events for educators and members.
- [Careers](https://careers.collegeboard.org/): Employment opportunities, workplace information, and recruiting resources.

## Students and Families
- [Student Home](https://students.collegeboard.org/): Central hub for students using SAT, AP, BigFuture, and college planning tools.
- [BigFuture](https://bigfuture.collegeboard.org/): College and career planning platform with search, planning, and scholarship tools.
- [College Search](https://bigfuture.collegeboard.org/colleges): Search and compare colleges by academics, cost, location, and fit.
- [Scholarship Search](https://bigfuture.collegeboard.org/scholarship-search): Find scholarships and financial aid opportunities for college funding.
- [Pay for College](https://bigfuture.collegeboard.org/pay-for-college): Guidance on financial aid, scholarships, and college affordability.
- [Career Search](https://bigfuture.collegeboard.org/careers): Explore careers by interests, salaries, education, and job outlook.
- [Student Account Sign In](https://account.collegeboard.org/login/login): Sign in to access scores, registrations, and student services.

## SAT Suite
- [SAT Home](https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/sat): Official SAT overview, registration, dates, scores, and preparation resources.
- [Register for the SAT](https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/sat/registration): Registration information, deadlines, and requirements for SAT test takers.
- [SAT Dates and Deadlines](https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/sat/dates-deadlines): National SAT administration dates, registration deadlines, and score release timing.
- [SAT Scores](https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/sat/scores): Score reporting, score interpretation, and sending SAT scores to colleges.
- [SAT Practice and Preparation](https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/sat/practice-preparation): Official SAT prep resources, practice tests, and study guidance.
- [PSAT/NMSQT](https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/psat-nmsqt): Information about the PSAT/NMSQT assessment and related student benefits.
- [PSAT 10](https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/psat-10): Overview of the PSAT 10 for students in grade 10.
- [PSAT 8/9](https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/psat-8-9): Overview of the PSAT 8/9 for earlier high school readiness assessment.

## AP Program
- [AP Students](https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/): Student-facing AP information on courses, exams, scores, and credit policies.
- [AP Central](https://apcentral.collegeboard.org/): Official AP resource center for teachers, coordinators, and administrators.
- [AP Courses and Exams](https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/courses): Browse AP subjects, course details, and exam information.
- [AP Exam Dates](https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/exam-dates): Annual AP Exam schedule and administration calendar.
- [AP Scores](https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/view-scores): Access and understand AP score reporting and score availability.
- [AP Credit Policy Search](https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/getting-credit-placement/search-policies): Search college AP credit and placement policies.
- [AP Classroom](https://apcentral.collegeboard.org/instructional-resources/ap-classroom): Instructional platform resources for AP teachers and students.

## Educators and Schools
- [Professional Home](https://professionals.collegeboard.org/): Hub for educators, counselors, and school staff across College Board programs.
- [SAT for Educators](https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/educators): SAT Suite resources for teachers, counselors, and administrators.
- [AP for Educators](https://apcentral.collegeboard.org/): AP program guidance, course resources, and exam administration support.
- [BigFuture School](https://bigfuture.collegeboard.org/bigfuture-school): College and career readiness tools designed for schools and districts.
- [K–12 Services and Programs](https://professionals.collegeboard.org/k-12-services): Overview of College Board services supporting K–12 schools and districts.
- [Counselor Resources](https://professionals.collegeboard.org/guidance): College planning and advising resources for school counselors.
- [College Readiness Assessments](https://professionals.collegeboard.org/assessment): Assessment resources for readiness, placement, and instructional planning.

## Higher Education and Placement
- [Higher Education Professionals](https://professionals.collegeboard.org/higher-ed): Resources for colleges and universities using College Board services.
- [ACCUPLACER](https://accuplacer.collegeboard.org/): Placement testing platform for colleges, adult learners, and workforce programs.
- [ACCUPLACER Tests](https://accuplacer.collegeboard.org/educators/tests): Details on ACCUPLACER assessments, content areas, and uses.
- [ACCUPLACER Study App](https://accuplacer.collegeboard.org/students): Student preparation resources for ACCUPLACER placement testing.
- [CLEP](https://clep.collegeboard.org/): Credit-by-exam program for earning college credit through standardized exams.
- [CLEP Exams](https://clep.collegeboard.org/clep-exams): Browse CLEP exam subjects, formats, and exam details.
- [Search CLEP Policies](https://clep.collegeboard.org/colleges-that-recognize-clep): Find colleges that grant credit for CLEP exam scores.

## Accommodations and Accessibility
- [Accommodations Home](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/): Central resource for disability accommodations across College Board tests.
- [Request Accommodations](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/request-accommodations): Steps, eligibility, and process for requesting testing accommodations.
- [SAT Accommodations](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/how-accommodations-work/for-each-test/sat): Accommodation policies and supports for SAT test takers.
- [AP Exam Accommodations](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/how-accommodations-work/for-each-test/ap-exams): Accommodation policies and supports for AP Exams.
- [SSD Online](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/ssd-online): Online system information for schools managing accommodation requests.
- [Help Center](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/help-center): FAQs and support articles about accommodations and SSD processes.
- [Student Eligibility Form](https://accommodations.collegeboard.org/request-accommodations/student-eligibility-form): Form for students who need to request accommodations outside school submission.

## Scores, Sending, and Student Services
- [Send SAT Scores](https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/sat/scores/send-scores-to-colleges): Send SAT score reports to colleges, universities, and scholarship programs.
- [Understanding SAT Scores](https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/sat/scores/understanding-scores): Explanation of SAT score structure, benchmarks, and score reports.
- [AP Score Reporting](https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/view-scores): Access AP scores and understand score release information.
- [Send AP Scores](https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/sending-scores): Send AP score reports to colleges and universities.
- [Score Verification Services](https://students.collegeboard.org/score-services): Student score service options, including verification and archived scores.
- [Student Search Service](https://students.collegeboard.org/student-search-service): Optional program connecting students with colleges and scholarship organizations.

## Research, Data, and Policy
- [Research Home](https://research.collegeboard.org/): Research portal for reports, trends, and evidence related to education and assessment.
- [SAT Suite Research](https://research.collegeboard.org/sat-suite): Research and validity studies for SAT Suite assessments.
- [AP Research](https://research.collegeboard.org/programs/ap): Research on AP participation, performance, and outcomes.
- [ACCUPLACER Research](https://research.collegeboard.org/programs/accuplacer): Research and technical information for ACCUPLACER assessments.
- [Trends in College Pricing and Student Aid](https://research.collegeboard.org/trends): Annual reports on college costs, aid, and affordability trends.
- [National Recognition Program](https://research.collegeboard.org/national-recognition-program): Program information and related data for academic recognition initiatives.

## Help and Support
- [College Board Help Center](https://support.collegeboard.org/): General support portal for students, families, and educators.
- [SAT Support](https://support.collegeboard.org/sat): Help articles and contact options for SAT-related questions.
- [AP Support](https://support.collegeboard.org/ap): Help articles and contact options for AP students and educators.
- [BigFuture Support](https://support.collegeboard.org/bigfuture): Help resources for BigFuture planning and account questions.
- [CLEP Support](https://support.collegeboard.org/clep): Support resources for CLEP registration, testing, and score reporting.
- [ACCUPLACER Help Center](https://accuplacer.collegeboard.org/help-center): FAQs and operational guidance for ACCUPLACER users.
